parameters.name: CertType
parameters.description:
The certificate type. Valid values:

- **CA**: CA certificate

- **CERT**: issued certificate

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to return. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: Identifiers
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of certificate identifiers.

parameters.name: KeyWord
parameters.description: The keyword for a fuzzy search by name, domain name, or subject alternative name.

parameters.name: ShowSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The default value is 50.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The source of the certificate. Valid values:

- **upload**: uploaded certificate

- **aliyun**: Alibaba Cloud certificate

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The certificate status. Valid values:

- **ISSUE**: issued

- **REVOKE**: revoked

parameters.name: WarehouseId
parameters.description: The warehouse ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListCertWarehouse](~~453246~~) API.
